23:15 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: College Football
The Colorado Buffaloes clash with the No. 17 Houston Cougars in Big 12 play. Colorado looks to defend its home turf following a 20-10 loss to Arizona State, while Houston relies on a 19.8 defensive scoring average to secure a conference road victory.
